src.jacobian.dr_dln_redge

src.jacobian.dr_dln_redge(i, j, state)[source]

Calculate derivative of \(r\) with respect to \(\ln\ r_{\rm edge}\).

Parameters:

  • i (int) – index

  • j (int) – index

  • state (dict) – current physical state of the system

Returns:

derivative of \(r\) with respect to \(\ln\ r_{\rm edge}\)

Return type:

float
